item.title: Author's Notes
item.content:encoded:
Alternatively titled, "cloud scorpion seeks lady red mantis mate" or "this is what happens when you are a nerd and try to write a love letter in biography form and then ask for your friends and family to read it".

Many, many thanks to Jekeled, Vivax, Silber, shaggydredlocks, Daily-SCP, AidenEldritch, and thedeadlymoose for reading this over in chat!

The Lady Zakuro also appears in the Serpent’s Hand tale Birdseed.

ETA: some basic trivia I learned from researching in relation to the insectkin court/culture/etc.

  • IRL mantises have five eyes. (and that is why the high mantis court loves circles.)
  • The promenade à deux is an actual scorpion mating behavior.
  • Female scorpions and mantises tend to be larger than males.
  • There are some very pretty mantises out there, like Orchid Mantis.
  • The Japanese names of the high mantid court members are all taken from chapter titles in The Tale of Genji.
